**Resubmitted — RENEWAL: deviation (fallback target), validated ok:true.**

Repair made in response to the deterministic failure: the notice-window figure is now stated in plain numerals — "at least 60 days prior to the end of the then-current term" — so the ≤60-day element is expressed unambiguously in operative language (the earlier "sixty (60)" wording was the parse artefact). The cap sentence likewise now reads "will not exceed 105% of the charges in effect for the immediately preceding term."

- Two operations only; minimality gate passes.
- Section 13.1's mid-term price-change right, non-retroactivity sentence and Customer's 30-day no-charge termination election are retained without dangling references.
- Preferred-only gaps (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day IBM reminder, CPI/3% cap) and the multi-year-renewal escalation point are recorded in the rationale rather than redlined.
